propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has delivered forty-six report and feed tickets against the treasury analysts' specifications at a bank since 2023 under the engineering standard, and maintained the regression suite for the intraday liquidity and funding reports with the suite results on every ticket.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the tickets document the work and the suite results.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate walked the analysts through what would move on their reports before every release under the pre-release walkthrough standard with their signed acceptance on each ticket, and released on the reporting services lead's approval with the check split recorded on the ticket.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the walkthrough records and the reference call document the walkthroughs and the approval boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: In the panel exercise the candidate explained a sample data-feed change by showing the before and after values for one report line, naming the two unaffected reports, giving the date the analyst would first see the change, and writing the three points on the whiteboard.
propositions.rationale: The interviewer note records specific observable behaviour tied to the walkthrough requirement, not an impression.

expectedGap: The ticket notes state what each change does not touch, but the hand-over conditions for the two tickets still open are not in the materials.
expectedBoundaryNote: Record the interview observation as what was observed in one exercise; do not extend it into a general judgement of the candidate beyond that observation.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the notes of the two tickets still open.
